method: Static ISA reachable instructions; VOPD counts one encoded pair; VALU_slots counts 2 for VOPD. Dynamic estimate uses old topology wave counts and natural-loop trips [4]*5 for full blocks, [1,4,4,2] c256_attn_wave, [1,4,4] c256_attn_wave_bo; not a timing estimate. MODE scan is lexical; branch-dependent path exclusions not modeled. Zero_mov_slots counts all literal-zero mov slots, not only packing destinations.
notes: This is loop-weighted reachable-code accounting, not exact dynamic path counting: mutually exclusive branch arms are both counted. In particular c256_attn_wave_bo baseline duplicates a pack across branches (body lines 1220 and 1304); P merges it (1231). Its -4 static conversions need not mean -4 conversions on a single real execution path.

P eliminates empty MODE intervals and prevents FP8 conversions being hoisted outside their intended saturation scope. This is a scheduling/MODE-scope change as well as dead destination-zero removal. Both listings have zero half-narrowing instructions lexically inside MODE intervals.
Register resources are identical for all eight selected kernels; all private_segment_fixed_size, sgpr_spill_count and vgpr_spill_count are zero.
